rules: Only Active, Waiting, and Needs Approval items are live.
No office may send, pay, delete, share private information, or file (including government filing) without approval.
One lead office and one support office per item.
Only the lead office tells the user.
If a loop repeats 3 times, escalate.
Calendar and alarms are the reminder system.
Keep a clear audit log for every action.
Keep all risky steps behind the approval gate.
